messages.content: The user already ran query_reminders. Use the delete_reminder tool exactly once to delete the reminder whose id is "test-reminder-id-DELETE". Then stop.

function.description: Permanently delete a reminder. Use query_reminders first to obtain the reminder_id. This is irreversible; the user is prompted before deletion.
function.name: delete_reminder

reminder_id.description: calendarItemIdentifier of the reminder to delete, from query_reminders.
